Horizon Retrospective 2026

A curated survey of pneumatic structures, fluid envelopes and kinetic public spaces.

Featured pavilion

Pavilion of Light & Atmosphere

A double-curved tensile membrane that responds to diurnal temperature shifts and solar incidence.

Prototype

Vascular Concrete Lattice

Concrete ribs threaded with capillary cooling loops for passive climate damping.

Theoretical

Acoustic Origami Facade

Parametric folding tiles tuned for urban noise diffusion and seasonal ventilation.

Built 2019

Inflatable Reading Cloud

A translucent ETFE canopy that inflates over a public library courtyard on rainy afternoons.
